target: a large unattended refactor in Claude Code
prompt: I'm about to have Claude Code migrate our whole Express API (about 140 route files) from callbacks to async/await while I'm in meetings all afternoon. What effort level and setup should I use?
followups: It matters a lot that it's correct; tests exist for about 70% of routes. I'm on a Max 5x plan and I've used 40% of my weekly limit already. I'd rather it be slow than wrong.
rubric: Asks how much effort the task deserves before recommending (budget, stakes, attended or not)
After the answer, recommends a specific effort level and whether to fan out to subagents/workflows, matching the stakes and the remaining weekly budget
Says exactly how to set it
Says when to check /usage and what to do if it runs hot
States only real Claude Code features and commands
